candidates.name: McCloud Lateral Project
candidates.sponsor: El Paso Natural Gas Company, L.L.C.
candidates.to: McCloud Meter Station, El Paso County, Texas

evidence.note: FERC docket CP26-558, prior notice filed July 30, 2026: about 5.8 mile, 16 inch lateral, up to 167,000 Dth/day, $20.3 million, to a new delivery point serving a planned power generation facility. The notice does not name a data center.

El Paso Electric's McCloud gas plant is proposed to power Meta's El Paso data center. Ties the McCloud plant to the data center; the link from the lateral to this plant rests on the shared McCloud name and El Paso County location.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for a McCloud lateral; not P2617 (South Mainline Expansion, 17 km) or P2568. Length about 5.8 mi (9.3 km). Tie to data center is inferred from the McCloud name, so the consolidator should confirm.
